page.overview:
Who is Furie Kanhen?

Kanhen is a very selfish person who allowed Chihare Amano to create a device from liquid chakra only to completely monopolise the energy market with it, after he would have destroyed the shinobi of every country by using Polar particles, and using the shinobi of the Land of Stairs to copy their natural gas with liquid chakra. From the perspective of Naruto Uzumaki, this was an unforgivable plan. Due to the fact that he is in charge of a large international organisation, Kanhen is calm about important people like the Hokage.

Kanhen is described as a man with pale lips and wearing a jacket.

Kanhen is a brilliant scientist capable of heading the Cultural Institute with its large number of workers. He was able to develop the Photon Gun, which is a very deadly weapon, and also integrate it into his entire army of drones, which he dispatched to attack Chihare Amano and Naruto Uzumaki. Kanhen also invented a trap with copper makibishi flying inside a magnetic field that would cut anyone caught inside the trap's perimeter. However, he is completely incapable of fighting on his own, and easily loses his battle with Naruto and Orochimaru.

At some point in time, before Naruto Uzumaki visited the Land of Stairs, Kanhen hired Yanaru Aze to kill the latter by equipping him with a photon weapon. However, his plan failed and Yanaru was caught and then committed suicide.
